subject: Allocation schedule and rev-rec treatment for OrbitSoft 3Y prepay
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@orbitsoft.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Allocation schedule and rev-rec treatment for OrbitSoft 3Y prepay

Hi Leah —

Thanks again for the productive pricing discussion yesterday. Per our talk, OrbitSoft is electing the 3-year prepaid option with the tiered term discount. To help your finance team close the PO and confirm internal accounting, we put together a recommended invoice allocation and suggested booking approach (attached).

High-level proposal:
- Total prepay: $1,200,000 over 3 years (paid up front)
- Proposed invoice split: 60% Year 1 / 25% Year 2 / 15% Year 3 (aligns with expected consumption ramp)
- Rev-rec suggestion: defer revenue and recognize ratably on the service start date, with a carveout for implementation professional services (if any) to be recognized on delivery.

Attachment: prepay-allocation-v2.xlsx — shows line-level GL mapping and per-fiscal-year amounts.

Can you confirm whether OrbitSoft needs a formal invoice per fiscal year (i.e., three separate invoices) or a single prepay invoice with a contract memo? Also, do you have a preference for the fiscal year boundary we should use (calendar year vs. FY starting July 1)?

I'll loop in Marcus for the rev-rec specifics. If useful, we can put together a short memo for your accounting team referencing ASC 606 guidance.

Next steps:
- Leah: confirm invoice-split preference + PO timing
- OrbitSoft billing contact (if different from Leah): provide billing email and GL/department codes
- Vanessa/Marcus: send final invoice package and DocuSign link

Thanks —

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@orbitsoft.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Moss <dan.moss@orbitsoft.com>
Date: 2027-03-23T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Allocation schedule and rev-rec treatment for OrbitSoft 3Y prepay

Vanessa —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) OrbitSoft prefers to receive one invoice now for the full prepay amount (our treasury likes a single upfront payment), but we need a supporting schedule that shows how you would allocate revenue across our fiscal years for our auditors.
2) Our FY runs Apr 1 — Mar 31, so Year 1 will span Apr 1, 2027 — Mar 31, 2028.
3) Please include an explicit note about deferred revenue accounting and any assumptions you used for the allocation (e.g., expected consumption ramp).

We will provide a PO within the week after receiving the formal invoice and schedule. Also cc'd Daniel (our head of accounting) to confirm GL codes once you share the schedule.

Best,

Leah
Leah Turner
VP Finance, OrbitSoft
leah.turner@orbitsoft.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@orbitsoft.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Allocation schedule and rev-rec treatment for OrbitSoft 3Y prepay

Leah/Vanessa —

Thanks — looping in a few practical accounting points so OrbitSoft's auditors have what they need. Key assumptions used in the attached workbook:
- Service start date: 2027-04-01 (matches OrbitSoft FY start)
- No significant implementation services included (service-only deal). If there are any deliverables that require separate revenue recognition, mark them as professional services and we'll separate those line items.
- Allocation method: expected consumption ramp (60/25/15) but we've also included a straight-line alternative tab in case you prefer ratable recognition.

ASC 606 note (brief):
- Prepayment itself is a contract liability (deferred revenue) on Redwood's books. Revenue is recognized as performance obligations are satisfied — here, as access to the inference service is provided over time, we recommend monthly recognition starting 2027-04-01.
- We'll provide an invoice that lists the total prepay amount and an attached allocation schedule for your internal accounting and audit trail.

Action items from Redwood (per our checklist):
- Produce single invoice for $1,200,000 with attached allocation schedule (PDF & XLSX) — Vanessa to send DocuSign/invoice package.
- Provide short rev-rec memo referencing ASC 606 and assumptions.
- Accept OrbitSoft GL codes for mapping on the allocation workbook.

I attached prepay-allocation-v2.xlsx and a 1-page memo (orbitsoft_prepay_term_sheet.pdf) with the accounting assumptions.

Cheers,

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-03-24T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Allocation schedule and rev-rec treatment for OrbitSoft 3Y prepay

Leah —

Quick note from contracts/finance ops before Vanessa issues the invoice package: please confirm the billing entity name and the remit-to details we should put on the invoice. We typically need:

- Billing entity (legal name)
- Remit-to address
- Billing email for payment notification
- PO number (once provided)
- GL / department code (optional but helpful)

If OrbitSoft wants the single invoice and the attached allocation schedule, we'll include a billing memo stating that revenue will be deferred and recognized monthly starting 2027-04-01 (per Marcus). We'll also attach the XLSX and a PDF schedule for audit documentation.

If you can confirm the remit info and PO by Friday, we'll generate the DocuSign invoice and send a payment link for wiring instructions.

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Contracts & Billing
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
